components.name: Hive Swarm Launcher
components.blurb: A rack of hungry drones. Many hands make it fast; one hand makes it sad.
components.quirk: Six tiny homing drones a salvo (+50% damage a second over the Artemis) but it fires at 0.4 the rate unless 3 crew stand in its room: Kett work in threes.

components.name: Chitin Thrower
components.blurb: Throws shed plate in a cone. It takes two to feed it, and no Kett has ever wished to be fewer.
components.quirk: A wide cone of chitin needles that splinter into the next cell, but it fires at half rate unless 2 crew stand in its room.

components.name: Drone Picket
components.blurb: Two crewmates, one watchful drone. The hive keeps its pickets in pairs.
components.quirk: A twin-drone turret that hits 30% harder than a Mk2 pulse turret, but it fires at half rate unless 2 crew stand in its room.
